text: The central authority coordinates intercity transit, dispute arbitration, and joint scheduling. During normal operation, it adds {变量1} units of coordination capacity; each city manages its own public warehouse stocks and bears the cost of local food, medicine, waterworks, schools, and workshops.

Local autonomy preserves each city's control over its public budget and provisioning, while sharing the costs of common deliberation. The central authority handles only intercity transit, dispute arbitration, and coordination within agreed limits. During normal operation, it adds {变量1} units of coordination capacity.

{变量1}: Requires {变量2} seconds of continuous preparation; during normal operation, approval +{变量3} per round, stalled -{变量4}. Governing by custom saves on written records, but increases expenditure on physical communications and mediation supplies. A written constitution requires more ongoing records in exchange for a higher coordination cap.

The shared law depends on every city continuing to provide support and honor its commitments. If payments fall behind, supplies are cut off, or a changeover stalls, national governance pauses and approval falls each round. It recovers each round once the shortfall is made up. The nation's history, each city's assets, and signed treaties are not erased by a changeover.
Repair and Resume Work in Parallel

Requires assigning two idle transport workers to escort the vehicle. After signing a trade agreement in the council house, up to six trips can be scheduled per batch. Vehicle-building materials and cargo are drawn from this city's original stockpile.
Ferry Medical Care and Embankment Repairs

The rails, signal lights, and locomotive traction prototypes have all passed inspection. You can now propose a rail spur and transfer station in the council house. Construction materials must still be hauled in batches by the original cargo trucks; train service can only be scheduled once construction is complete.

Once construction is complete, you can switch to rail service in the council house: it requires 4 transport workers on duty, carries 128 per trip, and reduces one-way travel time to 45 seconds. Each trip also expends 2 coal, 0.1 parts, and 0.05 tools. You can switch back to reinforced cargo trucks once the train returns to the station.
Axles and cargo boxes have been standardized. Supplies sent far away need a dedicated escort aboard.
Sturdy flatbed carts are parked in the convoy yard. Each yard can accommodate six transport workers; two must be assigned to run a round-trip trade route.
Agreements signed by several settlements need to be carefully archived together in one storeroom.
The administrative archives have begun recording contracts. They consume 0.04 knowledge every 10 seconds and provide two units of regional coordination capacity during normal operation.
Scattered mineral veins, river bends, and old rail beds have finally been pieced together into a complete map. The lights in the distance now have routes leading to them.

Goods are tracked in three separate ledgers: dispatch warehouse, in transit, and receiving warehouse. Build a convoy yard and assign two transport workers, and the Valley convoy will begin operating under the new system.
Local representatives can formally submit public works proposals and citizenship rules. The written commitments made by their predecessors will continue to be honored by those who take their place.
